coverage_notes.result_summary: Official CMS notices checked first: latest dated Nov 2. Twelve additional targeted searches (all returned results; none materially failed) for hospital and emergency, maternity, behavioral health, rural, ground/air EMS, dialysis, oncology, primary care, abrupt restoration, territories and CMS/CLIA found no newly effective, nonduplicate qualifying healthcare-access changes. Newly published Nov 8 Minnesota research concerns historical gaps, not a new access event. Roseland's maternity closure was announced Oct 1 and has occurred before this window; Nov 6 coverage is retrospective. Overnight local reporting may be under-indexed.
coverage_limitations: Bounded supplementary recall is not exhaustive national surveillance.
Overnight local reporting may be indexed with delay.
Production collection records were not independently searched for this run; exclusions rely on the verified prior watch receipt and original report dates.
